Early Voting Begins for US Midterm Elections

Early voting has commenced for the United States midterm elections, a contest that could determine control of Congress. The elections are a significant battle between the Democratic and Republican parties, with former President Donald Trump also a factor. Democrats have expressed optimism about potential gains, with some vowing to investigate Donald Trump's sons and Elon Musk if their party secures control of the House of Representatives.
